## What changes for users

<!-- One or two sentences. -->

## Proof

- [ ] Unit tests for new logic
- [ ] Fixture `mustFind` / control stays clean (for rules) — paste `jourilo bench` before/after if detection changed
- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally
- [ ] `plugin/dist` rebuilt and committed (`npm run build`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under "Unreleased"

## Honesty check

- [ ] Findings have the right kind (defect / hypothesis / needs-review), provenance and confidence
- [ ] No new network access, file writes or interactive actions without a flag and documentation
